known_behavior_summary: Normal order is random Red/Blue, the other color, then Green; Heroic prepends Black and repeats it after each Green (two independent verbatim sources in the ledger). The constructor now starts at the cycle start, so the first normal vial is random (it was always Blue); Maloriak respawns with a new AI after a wipe (Default Group), and Reset() also restarts the cycle defensively.
Release Aberrations selects up to three non-drowned chamber creatures per successful cast and has an 18-creature reserve (six successful casts); interrupted casts do not count.
DamageTaken enters phase two at 25% in every mode, cancels any unfinished cauldron visit, releases all remaining minions (two Prime Subjects included) and drinks all bottles.
The boss publishes read-only mechanic timers (GetTimeUntilEncounterMechanic) for the bot blackboard; publication into the blackboard is a coordinator patch.
Scorching Blast damage is split among targets by spell_custom_attr (77679, SHARE_DAMAGE).
SpellMgrCorrectionsPart04.cpp used to overwrite Biting Chill EFFECT_0 TargetA twice; the TargetB correction was applied in c0efb93a61.
Runtime 4.3.4 DBC rows match the 4.4.2 client rows for every Maloriak spell apart from radius indices (ledger dbc_434_parity_20260925).

The native AI schedules Release Aberrations in Red, Blue and Green (and, on 10N, possibly before the first vial); the bot never interrupts a release (user tactic) and kills each Aberration as it comes.
10N Biting Chill picks one player within 10 yd (every WCL pick was in melee range); other modes keep the 60-yd pick.
On 10N (round 3): Remedy heals base x tick number (ramp), Debilitating Slime strips Growth Catalyst, Berserk at 7 min, Prime Subjects cast Rend, Flash Freeze prefers players beyond 10 yd.

Round-3 fix (2026-09-30): the 2025-02-20 target is corroborated by five post-cutoff 10N kills and an official hotfix audit with no entry in 2025-01-13..2025-02-20 (ledger target_era_corroboration_10N); the Green Arcane Storm (3.66-6.57 s after Slime Imbued against 4.13-4.92 s), one Green Remedy (14.15 s against 7.3-10.9 s) and one Green Release begin (6.415 s against 7.3-10.5 s) differ, so the native 10N script draws them uniformly over 3.1-6.1 s, 7.3-14.2 s and 6.415-10.505 s and 10N is accepted (other modes keep 5 / 7.5 / 9 s).
